title: Release check-in with Angela and Balthasar

lines.speaker: nurse_angela
lines.text: Okay, I think we're all here. Balthasar, can you hear us okay?

lines.speaker: balthasar_davi
lines.text: Yep, loud and clear. Sorry, there's a leaf blower outside, if you hear that, that's not me.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: We'll pretend it's a test of slow networks.

lines.speaker: balthasar_davi
lines.text: Ha. Honestly, kind of.

lines.speaker: nurse_angela
lines.text: Alright, I'll keep this quick. I want to hear the sync fix first, because that's the big one on my list.

lines.speaker: balthasar_davi
lines.text: Yeah, so. The offline-sync conflict. The fix holds. I ran it on six devices, um, three Android, including the old Android 11 one, two of the newer phones, and the cheap tablet we use for the warehouse stuff.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: And that's the same repro as before? Same inspection, edited on two devices while offline?

lines.speaker: balthasar_davi
lines.text: Same repro. One inspection, two devices, both offline, both edit, then bring them back online at the same time. Before, one set of edits would just overwrite the other. Now both sets land and the findings are intact. I did it, I don't know, maybe a dozen times per device.

lines.speaker: nurse_angela
lines.text: Six devices, no failures?

lines.speaker: balthasar_davi
lines.text: No failures on the conflict. Zero.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: That's great. That was the one I was actually losing sleep over.

lines.speaker: balthasar_davi
lines.text: There's one other thing, though. Not the conflict, something separate.

lines.speaker: nurse_angela
lines.text: Go ahead.

lines.speaker: balthasar_davi
lines.text: Photo upload is flaky on slow networks. Like, if I throttle it down to bad warehouse wifi, every so often a photo upload just stalls. It doesn't lose the photo, it retries and it eventually gets there. It's just slow and the progress bar kind of sits there.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Does it ever lose one?

lines.speaker: balthasar_davi
lines.text: No. I checked that pretty carefully. Every photo made it. It's an annoyance, not a data problem.

lines.speaker: nurse_angela
lines.text: So, blocker or not a blocker? Your call.

lines.speaker: balthasar_davi
lines.text: Not a blocker. I'd document it. Known issue, photos may upload slowly on poor connections, they will finish.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Agreed. Balthasar, can you add it to the release notes, right under the known issues? Actually, we can probably take the old Android crash off that list now, since Tybalt fixed it.

lines.speaker: nurse_angela
lines.text: Yes, please, swap those. Okay, so where I am. Checklist's at ninety-five percent. Release notes, done once you make that edit. Store listing, done. Rollback plan, done. Support's got the FAQ.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: What's the last five?

lines.speaker: nurse_angela
lines.text: Balthasar's formal QA sign-off, which, it sounds like that's coming, and Tybalt's airplane-mode test. He told me this morning he's writing it.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Yeah, he volunteered in our one-on-one. He said he'd have it before go or no-go.

lines.speaker: balthasar_davi
lines.text: I'll send my sign-off tonight. I just want to write up the photo thing properly first so it's in there.

lines.speaker: nurse_angela
lines.text: Perfect. So nothing's moving. Go or no-go stays Friday, nine-thirty. Same room, I'll resend the invite so it's at the top of everyone's calendar.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Nine-thirty works. Thanks, both of you. Seriously, Balthasar, six devices, that's a lot of tapping.

lines.speaker: balthasar_davi
lines.text: My thumbs are fine. Mostly.

lines.speaker: nurse_angela
lines.text: Okay. See everyone tomorrow. Go enjoy your leaf blower.
